fusions.name: The Long Wait
fusions.desc: A single bite that deals 34 damage, is always a critical hit and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target already carries (max 40%).

fusions.name: Snap at the Scent
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Snaps across a cone 3 tiles long for 9 damage, with a 40% chance to leave each target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Water-Dance Bellow
fusions.desc: Bellows a warning that holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Strikes as It Lifts
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
